comparison.objective: Determine a two-lever combination and open a box, versus finish four HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential lever manipulation and state inference, not coaxial impact tooling or loose-fragment collection.

comparison.reason: Combination discovery and latch opening test different abilities and outcomes.
